# HighDimProb Code Knowledge Graph

This directory contains a pre-built code knowledge graph for the HighDimProb Lean 4 project, generated by [codebase-memory-mcp](https://github.com/anthropics/codebase-memory-mcp).

## Contents

- **HighDimProb.db** — SQLite knowledge graph database (3.9 MB)
  - 1,209 nodes (Functions, Sections, Modules, Files, Variables, Folders)
  - 2,721 edges (DEFINES, CALLS, USAGE, IMPORTS, etc.)
- **metadata.json** — Graph statistics and structure summary

## Usage

The database can be queried using the codebase-memory-mcp tool:

```bash
codebase-memory-mcp cli search_graph '{"project":"...","name_pattern":".*Pattern.*"}'
codebase-memory-mcp cli trace_path '{"function_name":"FuncName","direction":"both"}'
codebase-memory-mcp cli query_graph '{"query":"MATCH (f:Function) RETURN f.name LIMIT 10"}'
```

Or via the MCP server tools integrated with Claude Code and other agents.

## Graph Schema

### Node Labels
| Label    | Count | Description                        |
|----------|-------|------------------------------------|
| Section  | 490   | Lean sections/namespaces           |
| Function | 376   | Lean definitions/theorems/lemmas   |
| File     | 160   | Source files (.lean, .md, .yml)   |
| Module   | 160   | Lean modules                       |
| Variable | 17    | Lean variables/constants           |
| Folder   | 5     | Directory structure                |
| Project  | 1     | Root project node                  |

### Edge Types
| Type                  | Count | Description                    |
|-----------------------|-------|--------------------------------|
| DEFINES               | 1043  | Definition relationships       |
| CALLS                 | 809   | Function call relationships    |
| USAGE                 | 568   | Symbol usage references        |
| CONTAINS_FILE         | 160   | Directory containment          |
| IMPORTS               | 125   | Module import relationships    |
| CONTAINS_FOLDER       | 12    | Folder hierarchy               |
| SEMANTICALLY_RELATED   | 4     | Semantic similarity edges      |

### Architecture Layers
- **Entry points**: Concentration, Isotropic, MetricEntropy, RandomMatrix
- **Core libraries**: Distributions, Expectation, Nets, RandomVariable, RandomVector, Scalar, SubGaussian, Tail
- **Internal**: Covariance

## Regeneration

To regenerate the knowledge graph:

```bash
codebase-memory-mcp cli delete_project '{"project":"workspace-projects-HighDimProb"}'
codebase-memory-mcp cli index_repository '{"path":"/workspace/projects/HighDimProb"}'
cp ~/.cache/codebase-memory-mcp/workspace-projects-HighDimProb.db external/codebase-memory/HighDimProb.db
```
